compiled_state.title: As a plugin maintainer, merge-to-main-pr.sh autonomously resolves open GitHub review threads via GraphQL before merging
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend merge-to-main-pr.sh to autonomously resolve open GitHub review threads via the GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation, with bounded dispatch and push-induced dismissal detection.
**Why**: The PR-mode E2E success criteria require thread resolution; without this story merge-to-main-pr.sh only works on PRs with no open threads.
**Scope**:
- IN: reviewThreads GraphQL query for unresolved thread node IDs (PRRT_kwDO...); per-thread sonnet sub-agent dispatch (prompt template at plugins/dso/scripts/prompts/pr-comment-responder.md) to address each; REST POST /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/comments/{id}/replies for replies; resolveReviewThread GraphQL mutation; idempotent pre-check before resolveReviewThread; settling heuristic (CI green AND zero unresolved threads AND no new threads in last 120s); loop bounds (max dispatch count configurable default 10, wall-clock budget configurable default 30 min); push-induced approval dismissal detection; happy-path E2E verified in-session
- OUT: Required-checks blocking verification (S4); Ruleset provisioning (S5)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, each poll iteration fetches unresolved thread node IDs via the reviewThreads GraphQL query on the PullRequest; thread node IDs come from reviewThreads, NOT from REST /pulls/{n}/comments
  <- Satisfies: "programmatically resolves threads via the GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation"
- When this story is complete, for each unresolved thread, a sonnet sub-agent addresses the concern in code or via REST reply (POST /repos/{o}/{r}/pulls/{n}/comments/{id}/replies), then resolveReviewThread mutation is called
  <- Satisfies: "programmatically resolves threads via the GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation after addressing each in code or via REST reply"
- When this story is complete, resolveReviewThread is called only on threads confirmed unresolved (idempotent pre-check prevents silent loop divergence on already-resolved threads)
  <- Satisfies: implied by scenario analysis (resolveReviewThread called on already-resolved thread causes silent loop divergence)
- When this story is complete, settling heuristic: script declares done only when CI green AND zero unresolved threads AND no new threads in last 120s
  <- Satisfies: "exits zero after the merge commit lands on origin/main"
- When this story is complete, the autonomous thread-resolution loop has a maximum sub-agent dispatch count per PR (configurable, default 10) and a maximum wall-clock budget (configurable, default 30 min); when either limit is reached without settling, the loop escalates to the user with PR URL, unresolved thread IDs, and summary of attempted resolutions
  <- Satisfies: "Thread-resolution path: a thread the agent cannot programmatically resolve causes the loop to escalate to the user with the PR URL rather than spinning indefinitely"
- When this story is complete, the loop detects push-induced approval dismissal (when code pushes trigger dismiss_stale_approvals_on_push) and does not double-count restarted CI runs as separate poll timeouts
  <- Satisfies: implied by cross-story interaction between S3a CI polling, S3b code pushes, and S5 dismiss_stale_approvals_on_push knob
- When this story is complete, happy-path E2E: a real merge-to-main.sh --strategy=pr run on this repo's worktree completes autonomously — PR created, CI passes, threads resolved, branch merged, script exits 0; verified in-session via git log origin/main showing the merge commit
  <- Satisfies: "Happy-path E2E: a real merge-to-main.sh --strategy=pr run on this repo's worktree completes autonomously"
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Security] GitHub token needs contents:write scope for resolveReviewThread GraphQL mutation — verify token scope in CI context
- [Testing] GraphQL calls require live GitHub environment — mock-compatible interface needed for unit tests; gh api graphql calls must be abstracted behind a testable wrapper
- [Reliability] Sub-agent loop bound prevents runaway dispatch on adversarial reviewers or unaddressable threads

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
